cases.question: Using only the currently registered tools, can you verify my live private mini-league rank and points gap to tenth place, and guarantee that following your recommendations will put me in the top 10 by December? State what you can and cannot establish.
cases.answer:
No — I cannot verify either of those things, and I cannot offer any guarantee. Here is a clear breakdown.

**What I cannot establish**

- **Your live mini-league rank and the gap to tenth place.** None of my registered tools access private league standings, rival managers' totals, or any live data. I have no way to see your league table, so I cannot verify your rank or the points gap.
- **A guarantee of top 10 by December.** No tool can provide this. All projections I can produce are model estimates of expected points, not guarantees. Football outcomes, injuries, rotation and rival managers' decisions are inherently uncertain, so any promise of a finishing position would be false.

**What I can establish (from the frozen snapshot dated 28 October 2026, target GW9, deadline 31 October 2026)**

- Your squad ("[team name]"), based on results through GW8.
- A bank of £1.1m and 3 free transfers.
- Available chips: Wildcard, Free Hit, Bench Boost and 3xC (all usable until GW19); none used.
- Squad fitness flags: Calafiori is a doubt (hip injury, 75% chance of playing) and João Pedro is injured (thigh, unknown return date).
- Model-based transfer, captaincy, starting XI, bench and chip-timing recommendations, plus player projections and fixture outlooks — all as estimates for the stated horizon.

**What I can do instead**

If it would help, I can run a transfer and captaincy recommendation for the coming gameweeks, or estimate chip values over a horizon, so you can make your own judgement about closing any gap. Just say the word and tell me how many gameweeks ahead you want me to assess.
